title: Xtra-power PH2 65MM++ High Torque screw driver Bits with magnetic ring (10 pc set)
description: Are you annoyed dropping those little screws every time you have to assemble your furniture or machines? Xtra Power brings you High Torque Bits With Magnetic Ring to ease your assembling process. Don’t worry about dropping the screws, as XP Torque Bits comes with ph2 bits to hold that screw in place while you work effortlessly. It has a 65MM hex drive and a blue magnetic ring on top of the edge. It is made of sturdy material to withstand the extra speed of your machine, and it’s set of ten Torque Bits, so you don’t have to rush to store frequently. All bits are excellent performers, so you can consider this product as your investment in a long-lasting tool. It is simple to use a product designed to perform well with your industrial equipment, like screwdrivers or drill machines. However, to be cost and time efficient, XP Torque Bits are advised to be used with electric equipment.
